newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian MTBE - Steady amid thin regional demand.
newsitem.headline: Asian MTBE - Steady amid thin regional demand.

text.p: Asian MTBE prices are expected to hold steady despite the start of the summer driving season as regional buying interest remains thin, industry sources said on Thursday.
Free-on-board (fob) Singapore MTBE for June lifting was assessed unchanged at between $245 and $255 per tonne, although one less aggressive producer quoted as high as $260.
Traders said an improvement in U.S. MTBE prices has sparked off some enquiries for arbitrage cargoes and provided pyschological support.

But supplies are more than ample, especially with the imminent start up of the 700,000 tonne-per-year Sadaf plant in Al Jubail, a joint venture between Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC) and Royal Dutch Shell.
The plant is expected to start up by end May and at least 20-percent of production will come to Asia.
Traders said they saw prices holding steady in the near term.
"It will be flat in the next few weeks," said one producer. "Demand is not picking up, while supplies are good and domestic suppliers have high inventories."
Demand traditionally picks up during the summer months when gasoline consumption peaks, but Asian buying interest is so far limited to the monthly tender from Taiwan.
Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) is seeking its usual 3,500 to 7,000-tonnes of MTBE for delivery July 6-20 to Kaohsiung or Keelung, a company official said.
The tender closes May 28 and is valid for two days.
CPC's last spot tender, for June 10-24 delivery, was awarded to Italian producer Ecofuel at $267.50 per tonne, c-and-f Taiwan.
But on the bullish side, South Korean refiners will stop MTBE exports until September.
"The driving season is coming and domestic gasoline demand is increasing," a South Korean refiner said. "If gasoline demand increases, MTBE also increases."
He said he expected MTBE demand to rise by 3-4,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) as gasoline consumption rises by 40-50,000 bpd from 200,000-bpd between June and August.
